title.narrative: State Capture and Beyond: Entrenching Accountability and Democracy

description.narrative:
Overall objective: To contribute to strengthening accountability and transparency and to support anti-corruption initiatives to enhance public governance in South Africa.

Specific objective:

To improve capacities, engagement, dialogue, collaboration, and awareness on anti-corruption and accountability in both public and private sectors among CSOs, media, and local governments.
